subject: angol
title: Science and technology in everyday life
instructionsHu: A vizsgáztató a technika szerepéről a mindennapjaidban, a mesterséges intelligenciáról és a tudományról kérdez. Válaszolj részletesen, indokold a véleményedet, és mondj példákat.

questions.q: Which piece of technology has had the biggest impact on your life? Why?
How would your life be different without a smartphone?
followUps: Have you ever tried a digital detox?

questions.q: Do you use artificial intelligence tools, for example chatbots? What for?
Should students be allowed to use AI for their homework? Why or why not?
Are you interested in any area of science? Which one, and why?
followUps: Where do you learn about it?

questions.q: How do you protect your privacy online?
Do you think technology brings people closer together or pushes them apart?
Which scientific discovery or invention do you think has been the most important in history?
Why do you think fewer girls than boys choose careers in engineering or IT?
Which problem would you most like scientists to solve in your lifetime?

usefulPhrases.en: It has transformed the way I ...
It can be a useful tool if ...
It depends on how you use it.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Which piece of technology has had the biggest impact on your life? Why?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Without a doubt, my smartphone. I use it for practically everything, from chatting with friends to checking bus times and learning vocabulary, so it's hard to imagine a single day without it.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: How would your life be different without a smartphone?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Honestly, it would probably be calmer – I'd read more and sleep better. On the other hand, I'd be much more disorganised, because all my deadlines and plans are on my phone.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Have you ever tried a digital detox?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Yes, last summer at a scout camp where phones weren't allowed for a week. The first two days felt strange, but after that I was surprisingly relaxed and actually talked to people more.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Should students be allowed to use AI for their homework? Why or why not?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: I think so, but only with clear rules. Asking a chatbot to explain a difficult maths problem is really useful, but if it writes your whole essay, you don't learn anything. Teachers could ask us to explain how we used it, for example.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Do you think technology brings people closer together or pushes them apart?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: It does both, I'd say. My grandparents can video-call my cousin in London every Sunday, which brings them closer. Yet you often see families in restaurants where everyone is staring at their own screen.

notes: Feladat teljesítése: a vizsgázó minden kérdésnél indokol és példát hoz (cserkésztábor telefon nélkül, videóhívás a nagyszülőkkel), a mesterséges intelligenciáról szóló kérdésre pedig árnyalt, feltételhez kötött álláspontot fogalmaz meg konkrét javaslattal.

Nyelvhelyesség: a feltételes mód biztos használata (it would probably be calmer, I'd read more), szenvedő szerkezet (weren't allowed), 'from … to …' felsorolás és első feltételes mondat – hiba nélkül.
Szókincs: a technológia pontos szavai (digital detox, deadlines, disorganised, video-call) és természetes beszélt nyelvi fordulatok (Without a doubt, Honestly, I'd say).
Érdemes megtanulni: „Without a doubt”, „it's hard to imagine a single day without it”, „only with clear rules”, „It does both, I'd say”.
